results.title: Fed interest rate decision April 2026: Fed holds rates steady amid dissent
Federal Reserve Board - Implementation Note issued April 29, 2026
US Fed holds rates steady, Powell to remain on its board
Federal Reserve Board - Federal Reserve issues FOMC statement
Federal Reserve leaves interest rates unchanged as Powell's chairmanship nears end

summary: April 29, 2026 FOMC: held benchmark funds rate at 3.50-3.75%. Vote split 8-4 (last 4 dissents since Oct 1992). Three dissented against future cut language; one (Trump appointee Miran) dissented for immediate cut. Inflation noted as elevated partly due to Middle East energy prices. Market pricing: 0 cuts in 2026, 1 cut (25bp) in Dec 2027. Powell staying on Fed Board.
